property_summary: The reference transfer always returns true on success, while the mutant incorrectly returns false even when all sub-calls succeed.
For any admissible input where all internal calls succeed, the transfer function returns true; the mutant returns false, violating this invariant.
For any input where the call completes (does not revert), the reference returns true, but the mutant returns false.
For any input where transfer does not revert, the reference returns true, but the mutant returns false.
